title: Interpretable lexical drift benchmark
description: Drift monitors lack benchmarks that connect lexical substitutions to human-auditable semantic changes.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: Embedding metrics are not interpretable enough for substitution-level audits.
minimum_experiment_needed: Compare substitution probes against embedding shift metrics on labeled drift cases.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: NLP robustness datasets may already include substitution drift labels.
